d:
A Russian drone slams into a busy platform, at a railway station in Ukraine's Dnipro. At least 14 people were killed in the attack, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has called it a horrific strike. He has also demanded a response from Kyiv's allies. Gursshheen Gahllen tells you more on Vantage.
